object.attr: derived: CF-V23, review Q72. `include_trailer` lets an agent's commit read as a person's. Answered on 2026-11-11 (Q-V4), to confirm: only the person who starts the server can drop the trailer. The option's name is open. Replaces MELLON-VER-SRS-174.
object.description: The MCP server shall end the message of each commit the MCP server makes with the trailer `Via: mellon-mcp`, unless the server was started with the TBD option.
